operation: Omega-X: y = W.x, W in {-1,0,+1}^(m x n), x int8^n, y int32^m, exact

host.cpu_choice: most idle Cortex-X925 over 0.3 s (100% idle)
host.shared_machine: other sessions may run; blocks with run_delay > 2% of the block were retried (up to 8 times), costs are best-of and median of 9 interleaved blocks

bandwidth_method: best of three NEON xor-reduce read kernels (ld1x4, independent q loads, 4 concurrent streams), hot buffer of the given size, best of 7 each, >= 64 MiB read per sample; roofline floor = working_set_bytes / read_gbs at the smallest measured size >= working set

realizations.label: int8 W, plain C loop (-O2), weak baseline
int8 W, NEON SDOT 4 rows x 64 B, 8 accumulators
int8 W in 4-row interleaved tiles (one stream), NEON SDOT, 8 accumulators
int8 W, I8MM SMMLA row-pair interleaved (half of each 2x2 unused)
pos/neg bitplanes (2 b/w), vtst byte masks -> SDOT
T-MAC style 4-activation subset-sum LUT (2 b/w), vqtbl4q + USDOT
2-bit two's-complement crumbs (2 b/w), shift-pair decode -> SDOT
uint16 +1/-1 index lists per row, scalar gather add/sub
RNS {256,255,253}, 3 fused SDOT channels + mixed-radix CRT
5 trits/byte (1.6 b/w), NEON divide-by-3 decode then SDOT

energy.scope: aien_spbm cpu_p = whole Cortex-X925 cluster (10 cores), updates about every 0.1 s; idle 0.4 s then run 0.8 s per realization; dynamic = run minus idle power; indicative only on a shared machine
